answer: Verifiers send each agent ID signed challenges from five regions at random moments, and replies must arrive within 40 ms, which pins the ID to one host. Two fakes on one box get pinged in the same comet burst and the second reply lands late. A farm of 300 IDs needs 300 machines on distinct routes, rented every month. A hollow ID on a shared server misses its window and drops out of the task river.
